arabic: وَٱلطُّورِ
translation: By the Mount

arabic: وَكِتَٰبٖ مَّسۡطُورٖ
translation: And a Book inscribed

arabic: فِي رَقّٖ مَّنشُورٖ
translation: In a published scroll

arabic: وَٱلۡبَيۡتِ ٱلۡمَعۡمُورِ
translation: And the frequented House

arabic: وَٱلسَّقۡفِ ٱلۡمَرۡفُوعِ
translation: And the elevated roof

arabic: وَٱلۡبَحۡرِ ٱلۡمَسۡجُورِ
translation: And the seething sea

arabic: إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّكَ لَوَٰقِعٞ
translation: The punishment of your Lord is coming

arabic: مَّا لَهُۥ مِن دَافِعٖ
translation: There is nothing to avert it

arabic: يَوۡمَ تَمُورُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ مَوۡرٗا
translation: On the Day when the heaven sways in agitation

arabic: وَتَسِيرُ ٱلۡجِبَالُ سَيۡرٗا
translation: And the mountains go into motion

arabic: فَوَيۡلٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ
translation: Woe on that Day to the deniers

arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ فِي خَوۡضٖ يَلۡعَبُونَ
translation: Those who play with speculation

arabic: يَوۡمَ يُدَعُّونَ إِلَىٰ نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ دَعًّا
translation: The Day when they are shoved into the Fire of Hell forcefully

arabic: هَٰذِهِ ٱلنَّارُ ٱلَّتِي كُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ
translation: “This is the Fire which you used to deny

arabic: أَفَسِحۡرٌ هَٰذَآ أَمۡ أَنتُمۡ لَا تُبۡصِرُونَ
translation: Is this magic, or do you not see

arabic: ٱصۡلَوۡهَا فَٱصۡبِرُوٓاْ أَوۡ لَا تَصۡبِرُواْ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيۡكُمۡۖ إِنَّمَا تُجۡزَوۡنَ مَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
translation: Burn in it. Whether you are patient, or impatient, it is the same for you. You are only being repaid for what you used to do.”

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنَّٰتٖ وَنَعِيمٖ
translation: But the righteous will be amid gardens and bliss

arabic: فَٰكِهِينَ بِمَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ وَوَقَىٰهُمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ عَذَابَ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
translation: Enjoying what their Lord has given them, and their Lord has spared them the suffering of Hell

arabic: كُلُواْ وَٱشۡرَبُواْ هَنِيٓـَٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
translation: Eat and drink happily, for what you used to do

arabic: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ سُرُرٖ مَّصۡفُوفَةٖۖ وَزَوَّجۡنَٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٖ
translation: Relaxing on luxurious furnishings; and We will couple them with gorgeous spouses

arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَٱتَّبَعَتۡهُمۡ ذُرِّيَّتُهُم بِإِيمَٰنٍ أَلۡحَقۡنَا بِهِمۡ ذُرِّيَّتَهُمۡ وَمَآ أَلَتۡنَٰهُم مِّنۡ عَمَلِهِم مِّن شَيۡءٖۚ كُلُّ ٱمۡرِيِٕۭ بِمَا كَسَبَ رَهِينٞ
translation: Those who believed and their offspring followed them in faith—We will unite them with their offspring, and We will not deprive them of any of their works. Every person is hostage to what he has earned

arabic: وَأَمۡدَدۡنَٰهُم بِفَٰكِهَةٖ وَلَحۡمٖ مِّمَّا يَشۡتَهُونَ
translation: And We will supply them with fruit, and meat; such as they desire

arabic: يَتَنَٰزَعُونَ فِيهَا كَأۡسٗا لَّا لَغۡوٞ فِيهَا وَلَا تَأۡثِيمٞ
translation: They will exchange therein a cup; wherein is neither harm, nor sin

arabic: ۞ وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ غِلۡمَانٞ لَّهُمۡ كَأَنَّهُمۡ لُؤۡلُؤٞ مَّكۡنُونٞ
translation: Serving them will be youths like hidden pearls

arabic: وَأَقۡبَلَ بَعۡضُهُمۡ عَلَىٰ بَعۡضٖ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
translation: And they will approach one another, inquiring

arabic: قَالُوٓاْ إِنَّا كُنَّا قَبۡلُ فِيٓ أَهۡلِنَا مُشۡفِقِينَ
translation: They will say, “Before this, we were fearful for our families

arabic: فَمَنَّ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيۡنَا وَوَقَىٰنَا عَذَابَ ٱلسَّمُومِ
translation: But God blessed us, and spared us the agony of the Fiery Winds

arabic: إِنَّا كُنَّا مِن قَبۡلُ نَدۡعُوهُۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلۡبَرُّ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation: Before this, we used to pray to Him. He is the Good, the Compassionate.”

arabic: فَذَكِّرۡ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِنِعۡمَتِ رَبِّكَ بِكَاهِنٖ وَلَا مَجۡنُونٍ
translation: So remind. By the grace of your Lord, you are neither a soothsayer, nor a madman

arabic: أَمۡ يَقُولُونَ شَاعِرٞ نَّتَرَبَّصُ بِهِۦ رَيۡبَ ٱلۡمَنُونِ
translation: Or do they say, “A poet—we await for him a calamity of time”

arabic: قُلۡ تَرَبَّصُواْ فَإِنِّي مَعَكُم مِّنَ ٱلۡمُتَرَبِّصِينَ
translation: Say, “Go on waiting; I will be waiting with you.”

arabic: أَمۡ تَأۡمُرُهُمۡ أَحۡلَٰمُهُم بِهَٰذَآۚ أَمۡ هُمۡ قَوۡمٞ طَاغُونَ
translation: Or is it that their dreams compel them to this? Or are they aggressive people

arabic: أَمۡ يَقُولُونَ تَقَوَّلَهُۥۚ بَل لَّا يُؤۡمِنُونَ
translation: Or do they say, “He made it up”? Rather, they do not believe

arabic: فَلۡيَأۡتُواْ بِحَدِيثٖ مِّثۡلِهِۦٓ إِن كَانُواْ صَٰدِقِينَ
translation: So let them produce a discourse like it, if they are truthful

arabic: أَمۡ خُلِقُواْ مِنۡ غَيۡرِ شَيۡءٍ أَمۡ هُمُ ٱلۡخَٰلِقُونَ
translation: Or were they created out of nothing? Or are they the creators

arabic: أَمۡ خَلَقُواْ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَۚ بَل لَّا يُوقِنُونَ
translation: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? In fact, they are not certain

arabic: أَمۡ عِندَهُمۡ خَزَآئِنُ رَبِّكَ أَمۡ هُمُ ٱلۡمُصَۜيۡطِرُونَ
translation: Or do they possess the treasuries of your Lord? Or are they the controllers

arabic: أَمۡ لَهُمۡ سُلَّمٞ يَسۡتَمِعُونَ فِيهِۖ فَلۡيَأۡتِ مُسۡتَمِعُهُم بِسُلۡطَٰنٖ مُّبِينٍ
translation: Or do they have a stairway by means of which they listen? Then let their listener produce a clear proof

arabic: أَمۡ لَهُ ٱلۡبَنَٰتُ وَلَكُمُ ٱلۡبَنُونَ
translation: Or for Him the daughters, and for you the sons

arabic: أَمۡ تَسۡـَٔلُهُمۡ أَجۡرٗا فَهُم مِّن مَّغۡرَمٖ مُّثۡقَلُونَ
translation: Or do you demand a payment from them, and they are burdened by debt

arabic: أَمۡ عِندَهُمُ ٱلۡغَيۡبُ فَهُمۡ يَكۡتُبُونَ
translation: Or do they know the future, and they are writing it down

arabic: أَمۡ يُرِيدُونَ كَيۡدٗاۖ فَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ هُمُ ٱلۡمَكِيدُونَ
translation: Or are they planning a conspiracy? The conspiracy will befall the disbelievers

arabic: أَمۡ لَهُمۡ إِلَٰهٌ غَيۡرُ ٱللَّهِۚ سُبۡحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشۡرِكُونَ
translation: Or do they have a god besides God? God transcends what they associate

arabic: وَإِن يَرَوۡاْ كِسۡفٗا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ سَاقِطٗا يَقُولُواْ سَحَابٞ مَّرۡكُومٞ
translation: Even if they were to see lumps of the sky falling down, they would say, “A mass of clouds.”

arabic: فَذَرۡهُمۡ حَتَّىٰ يُلَٰقُواْ يَوۡمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِي فِيهِ يُصۡعَقُونَ
translation: So leave them until they meet their Day in which they will be stunned

arabic: يَوۡمَ لَا يُغۡنِي عَنۡهُمۡ كَيۡدُهُمۡ شَيۡـٔٗا وَلَا هُمۡ يُنصَرُونَ
translation: The Day when their ploys will avail them nothing; and they will not be helped

arabic: وَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ عَذَابٗا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
translation: For those who do wrong, there is a punishment besides that; but most of them do not know

arabic: وَٱصۡبِرۡ لِحُكۡمِ رَبِّكَ فَإِنَّكَ بِأَعۡيُنِنَاۖ وَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ
translation: So patiently await the decision of your Lord, for you are before Our Eyes; and proclaim the praises of your Lord when you arise

arabic: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيۡلِ فَسَبِّحۡهُ وَإِدۡبَٰرَ ٱلنُّجُومِ
translation: And glorify Him during the night, and at the receding of the stars
